items.title: Hackers Use AI-Assisted PowerShell Toolkit With 41 Modules to Target African Stock Exchange
items.description: Hackers ran 41 PowerShell modules on a compromised server at a major African stock exchange in just three minutes and 12 seconds. The toolkit searched for passwords, cloud keys, and database credentials, then tested whether it could access the exchange’s investment application programming interface (API) and a securities depository gateway. items.title: Wireshark 4.6.10 Released With Patch for 39 Security Vulnerabilities
items.description: Wireshark 4.6.10 has been released with fixes for 39 security vulnerabilities affecting protocol dissectors, capture file parsers, the dissection engine, and audio codecs. The update addresses crashes, processing loops, memory leaks, and a heap disclosure issue that could affect systems used for network troubleshooting and security analysis. All three companies said their own networks were not breached. items.title: Drupal Fixes Critical RCE Flaw That Could Let Unauthenticated Hackers Take Over Websites
items.description: Drupal released security updates on November 18 to fix a critical flaw that could let attackers take over vulnerable websites without logging in. The bug, tracked as CVE-2026-132165, affects the installer included with Drupal core. items.title: New Unpatched Windows 0-Day FastUnlock Lets Someone Holding a Locked PC Run Programs on It
items.description: A newly disclosed unpatched zero-day technique called FastUnlock lets someone with physical access to a locked Windows computer start programs without signing in. Whoever uses it gets only a limited account, not administrator control of the machine. The method was posted yesterday by a researcher who uses the handles MSNightmare and Nightmare Eclipse, and the endpoint-security firm ThreatLocker
